placements.role: Operates Samsung Foundry with first-generation 2nm products in mass production; second-generation 2nm ramp remains a 2026 plan.

role_evidence.claim: Samsung's official FY2025 results say its Foundry Business commenced mass production of first-generation 2nm products in the fourth quarter of 2025; separately, the same release says it plans to ramp second-generation 2nm products during 2026 and expects orders from HPC and mobile customers.
role_evidence.source_name: Samsung Electronics fourth-quarter and FY2025 results

placements.role: Provides available 2.5D heterogeneous packaging that integrates logic dies with HBM.

role_evidence.claim: Samsung announced immediate availability of I-Cube4, a 2.5D packaging technology integrating four HBM dies and one logic die on a silicon interposer.

placements.role: Designs and volume-manufactures high-bandwidth memory for AI accelerators.

role_evidence.claim: Samsung says it began HBM4 mass production and shipped commercial products to customers in February 2026.

business_summary: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. is a KOSPI-listed conglomerate whose semiconductor division spans memory, foundry and packaging. For this chain it is unusual in sitting on three links at once, which is also why no single placement describes it: the same issuer is a leading-edge foundry competitor, an advanced-packaging supplier and an HBM manufacturer, and its consolidated financials also carry a large consumer-electronics business that has nothing to do with this chain.

exposure_summary.narrative: Three ACTIVE placements, all VERIFIED from Samsung's own newsroom and results releases: foundry (position 6, heat CROWDED) on first-generation 2nm mass production, advanced-packaging (position 7, heat EMERGING) on I-Cube4 2.5D integration, and hbm-memory (position 8, heat CROWDED at crowdedness 78) on HBM4 commercial shipment in February 2026. It is the broadest exposure in this batch and the most diluted: the placements are real, but they sit inside a group whose revenue is dominated by businesses outside this chain.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: Samsung reports by division (DS, DX, SDC, Harman) rather than by AI end market, and no percentage of revenue attributable to foundry, advanced packaging or HBM was read from a primary Samsung source this run.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (333,605,938,000,000/302,231,360,000,000)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income 43,601,051,000,000 KRW divided by revenue 333,605,938,000,000 KRW, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 85,315,148,000,000 KRW divided by net income 44,260,956,000,000 KRW, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 85,315,148,000,000 KRW less capex 52,153,149,000,000 KRW, divided by revenue 333,605,938,000,000 KRW, all for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -32,617,239,000,000 KRW (total debt 25,239,139,000,000 less cash 57,856,378,000,000, as of 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy 90,527,643,000,000 KRW (operating income 43,601,051,000,000 plus depreciation 46,926,592,000,000 for the period ended 2025-12-31), from the yfinance-statements series.

piotroski.basis: Piotroski F-score 5 (state MIDDLING) computed over yfinance-statements statements in 005930-KS.json quality.piotroski, 9 of 9 inputs found.

beneish_state.basis: Beneish M-score -2.645 against the -1.78 threshold, earnings-manipulation state CLEAN, computed over yfinance-statements statements in 005930-KS.json quality.beneish, 12 of 12 inputs found.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 1,703,956,295,466,000 KRW computed in 005930-KS.json quality.derived.market_cap from vendor/official share count and price (method section 6A vendor-aggregate fundamentals).

price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 1,703,956,295,466,000 KRW divided by revenue 333,605,938,000,000 KRW for the period ended 2025-12-31.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 1,671,339,056,466,000 KRW implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 33,161,999,000,000 KRW, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over yfinance-statements statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon ({'5': 0.3207, '7': 0.2377, '10': 0.1791}). Measures how much of the expectation reading is a horizon convention rather than a price statement.

crowdedness_caveats: Samsung sits on two CROWDED links (foundry at crowdedness 72, hbm-memory at 78) and one EMERGING one (data/chains/ai-infrastructure.json).
data/market/005930-KS.json carries a single-source price print rather than an agreed dual-source one, and no pcs block, so neither price confidence nor crowdedness was measured for this listing.

The conglomerate structure is itself a crowdedness caveat in the opposite direction: the AI exposure is real but diluted, so the stock is a weaker expression of this chain than a pure-play would be, whatever the coverage.
No valuation multiple is computed anywhere on this profile, so this file contains no basis for a priced-in judgement.

catalysts.claim: Samsung's own release says it began HBM4 mass production and shipped commercial products to customers in February 2026, which is the dated basis of the hbm-memory placement.

Samsung's official FY2025 results say its Foundry Business commenced mass production of first-generation 2nm products in the fourth quarter of 2025 and plans to ramp second-generation 2nm during 2026, which is the dated basis of the foundry placement.

catalysts.claim: Newly filled fundamentals (2026-08-30, yfinance-statements) show 3.35% three-year revenue CAGR, a CLEAN Beneish read (-2.645), a 13.07% operating margin, the strongest evidence this profile carries for the 005930.KS placement.

risks.claim: The advanced-packaging placement rests on the I-Cube4 availability release of 2021-05-06, which is nearly five years older than every other placement evidence item in this batch. It establishes that the capability exists, not that it is currently winning AI packaging volume.
No admissible financial fact exists for this issuer, so its three placements cannot be weighed against revenue, margin, leverage, earnings quality or valuation at all.
